epoch_scope: Single selected raw SPD/SAD observation per device; collection consistency retained separately
scope: Fixed IPv4 tunnel ESP configurations; Red-host payload origins. OVS NORMAL switching overapproximated by all physical bridge member destinations. Additional drop-only checks and local-route distinctions are overapproximated, not exact acceptance.
remaining: This importer supplies the native IPv4 configuration; separate generated local stack, full-label, byte-response and positive-path modules must be validated together
Socket-bound IKE bypass remains scoped to the captured trusted IKE programs
Authenticated encrypted assembly uses the declared cryptographic and kernel-processing correspondence; ordinary fragment keys do not establish shared provenance
Separate IPv6, MACsec, carrier and FreeBSD applications retain their own backend scope and completion records
